full_prompt_en: A square fantasy illustration presents a broad-shouldered simian warrior standing before an elaborately carved stone doorway. He turns partly toward the left, holding a long sword upright with both hands near the lower left of the frame. A circular metal ornament sits across his brow above small, intent eyes. Gray hair and a heavy beard surround his face, while a thick pale fur collar rises around the red sleeves of his coat. Leather straps, metal fittings and embroidered cloth add layers of worn detail. Behind him, the turquoise green doors and vertical stone panels are filled with carved symbols and repeating reliefs. Their cool color sets off the warm red of the coat and the brown gray fur. Light from the upper left catches the forehead piece, nose, knuckles, fur tips and edges of the sword; recesses in the carving and folds of cloth remain dark. The figure fills most of the left and central field, leaving only narrow strips of architecture visible around him. Finely painted textures distinguish fur, weathered skin, engraved metal and old stone without losing the main silhouette. The image has the weight of a book cover or adventure painting: exact detail at the face and weapon, broader shadow at the margins, and a tense stillness before action.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形奇幻插画呈现一个宽肩猿人武士，站在雕刻繁复的石门前。他身体略向左转，双手在画面左下附近握着竖起的长剑。圆形金属饰物横在额上，下面是一双专注的小眼睛。灰发与浓重胡须环住面部，厚实浅色毛领从红色外套袖子周围竖起。皮带、金属件和刺绣布料叠出磨旧细节。身后的青绿色门扇与竖向石板布满雕刻符号及重复浮雕。冷色衬出外套的暖红与毛皮的棕灰。左上来光照到额饰、鼻梁、指节、毛尖和剑刃边缘；雕刻凹处与衣褶仍然幽暗。形体占据左侧和中央大部，周围只剩狭窄建筑条带。精细绘制的纹理区分毛发、粗糙皮肤、刻花金属与旧石，同时保持主剪影的清楚。画面有冒险小说封面般的重量：脸和武器最为精准，边缘阴影宽大，动作开始前的紧张静止弥漫其中。
style_prompt_en: The fantasy painting uses dense material detail within a strong, readable silhouette. Weathered turquoise and stone gray sit behind warm red, brown and pale fur tones. A directional upper light catches raised surfaces, leaving carved recesses and folds in deep shadow. Brushwork moves from finely articulated textures at the center to broader, darker masses at the edges. Repeating relief patterns add a steady vertical rhythm behind the rounded focal shape. The result is tactile, weighty and dramatic without losing clarity.
style_prompt_zh: 这种奇幻绘画在清楚有力的剪影内布置密集材质细节。磨旧青绿与石灰色位于后方，前景是暖红、棕色和浅毛色调。上方定向光挑亮凸起表面，雕刻凹处与褶隙留在深影里。笔触从中央精细的纹理过渡到边缘更宽更暗的色块。重复浮雕纹样在圆润焦点形体后建立稳定竖向节奏。整体可触、厚重而有戏剧性，同时保持清楚。
theme_en: A fur-collared simian warrior holding an ornate sword
theme_zh: 握着华丽长剑的毛领猿人武士
name: Clyde Caldwell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
